text: The unexamined life is not worth living.
author: Socrates
description: Socrates believed that a meaningful life requires questioning yourself, your beliefs, and the world around you. Instead of blindly following society, examine why you do what you do. Ask yourself whether your choices reflect your values and whether you are becoming the person you want to be.

author: Albert Camus
description: Camus explored the absurdity of searching for meaning in an indifferent universe. Sisyphus is condemned to push a boulder uphill forever, yet Camus suggests that accepting this reality and continuing to live on your own terms can itself become an act of freedom.

text: the guy who likes walking is gonna walk further, then the guy who likes the destination.
author: Sam Sulek
description: Thought about finale destination can give you instant motivation. But if after days or mounts of hard work you don't see results, motivation will fade away real quick. The right way is ti fall in love with the process. If everyday you wake up feeling at least a little bit exited about hard work you will do today, it is already a win.

text: you cannot fail, if you try your best
author: Andrew Tate
description: If you give your absolute best. Not like 'I really tried', not the 110%. I mean when all you can think about is you goal. When quiting has not crossed your mind. Then you cannot fail, you will win, maybe you put your whole life to sees one goal, doesn't metter how big the goal is, you will successed, if you try your best.

text: as long as I live, there are infinite chances
author: Monkey D Luffy
description: You can lose everything and everyone, but comeback is always possible. Luffy never thought about failing, he was always going towards his dream with smile on his face. He was defeated by Kaido two times, but that didn't stoped him from coming back and fight third time. He knew that if he breaths he still can win, doesn't matter what happened in the past.

text: Don't ever let somebody tell you... You can't do something. Not even me. All right?... You got a dream... You gotta protect it. People can't do somethin' themselves, they wanna tell you you can't do it. If you want somethin', go get it. Period.
author: The Pursuit of Happyness 2006
description: When somebody says 'it is not possible' or 'you can't'. They show their limit, they dicided in their head that they can't. When you say to them I will do it, they know that if you successed that will break limits they made in their heads. So they will try to stop you, to pretect their comfort. It is important to not give a fuck about that, but go and get what you want.

text: There is as much happiness and magic in life as you can notice
author: Rolands Prohorovs
description: There is so much magic, cool things in life, but we often don't see them. We go by the most beatifull sunset of our life, looking at our phone checonking something 'important'. We, people, need to push our self to see magic and search for happiness. A lot in life depens on how you think, on your mindset. If you put it to seeing beatifull things in small moments, if something good happens and you don't say 'ahhh coincidence' but you say 'that's magical' you will live much happiest life!

text: Maybe it's not about happy ending, maybe it's about the story
author: Albert Camus
description: We often think about life like something that always should be great, funny and happy. But eventially everyone undertands that life is not only rainbows and sunshines. There is a lot of evil in life, a lot evil people. And sometimes you can't choose what happens to you, and will find youself in very hard situation. Maybe your life won't have a happy ending, but maybe it's not about that, maybe it's about the story, about still fighting when eveything seems pointless, maybe it's about not giving up and finding meaning even in the hardest times. Maybe it's about believing you can get a happy ending.

text: A smooth see never made a skilled sailor
author: Franklin D. Roosevelt
description: When we complain about hard times, chalanges life is throwing at us or something that didn't went as we wanted to. We are wishing for easy life but, but as they say be carefull what you wish for. Easy life can mean you won't be strong, won't be wise, won't be kind, so it is good to ask youself a question: Are you ready to accept that? Do you want to live all you life in comfort and never know what you really are made of, what are you capable of, what are your limits. Or you want to accept hard time, chalanges and face them with gratitude and spirit of a warrior who came to discover and conquer himself.

text: A brad who is afraid to be hurn isn't qualified to love someone.
author: Eikichi Onizuka
description: Everythings comes with a cost even heaven demand death, even something beautiful as love will hurt and sometimes much harder than any other physical pain. If you are scared of that, and because of that play with other peoples feeling and complain how hard life is, then who are you if not just one more coward. If you love, don't be scared, love fully, with open heart, give everything you got, and you will find someone who will do the same for you.
